C-SHARED-TERMINOLOGY.IntentSummary: Carry out the owner-approved terminology reconciliation at the existing corpus and portal owners: correct the bilingual rules and definitions, record the decision, integrate the requested English companion and verify the complete source-to-page path.

T-001.Title: Reconcile the bilingual terminology rules and record the decision

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Rules permit common terms; meanings and operational facts are preserved, with bilingual definitions and dated change records.

T-002.Title: Integrate the English companion and regenerate the portal

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The companion is reachable, its source language is explicit, and all canonical sources and generated links remain covered.

T-003.Title: Verify the reconciled meaning and actual rendered pages

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Paired definitions, historical versus current wording, source metadata and browser behavior agree with the owner's accepted naming rule.
